name: step-dialog
title: Step Dialog
description: A multi-step form on one schema, in a Dialog or inline: a progress list with aria-current, Next validates only the current step, Back keeps values, focus moves to each step's heading, and a failed submit returns to the step with the error.
docs: `<StepDialog trigger title description schema defaultValues steps onSubmit labels>`, or `<StepForm>` inline with the same props (no dialog ones). `steps` is `{ id, title, description?, render: (form) => …, fields?, validate? }[]`: `render` returns the step's `FormField`s, `fields` lists what Next validates (the step's mounted fields by default) and `validate(values)` runs after them, returning nothing or an error in any shape `onSubmit` throws. Next and Enter validate only the current step; Back keeps every value; the last step's button submits the whole schema through `onSubmit`, with Form's error mapping. A failed validation or a server field error returns to the step that holds the field (`fields`, or the fields seen there). Focus moves to the step's heading (`h2` inline, `h3` in the dialog, `headingLevel` on StepForm) on Next and Back, and to the first invalid field after an error. The progress is an `<ol>` with `aria-current="step"` on the current step, named by `labels.progress`. `step`/`defaultStep` and `onStepChange(id, { index, previous, direction })` (`next`, `back` or `error`). `labels` (`next`, `back`, `submit`, `progress`, and `cancel` in the dialog) default to English. Agents fill each step's fields by label and press Next, Back and the submit button by name. StepDialog closes when `onSubmit` resolves, ignores Escape, outside presses and Cancel while pending, and starts over each time it opens.
